parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation lid of the storage box, made of polypropylene plastic. It is rectangular and attached to the base body via hinges.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers and protects the contents of the box. It can be opened or closed to access or secure the stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge axis to open or close the box.

parts.name: Lock (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left locking mechanism of the box, made of ABS plastic. It is a small latch component attached to the upper edge of the box.
parts.Functional_description: It secures the lid in a closed position by snapping into place when the lid is shut.
parts.Movement_description: It can be pressed or lifted slightly to engage or disengage the locking mechanism.

parts.name: Lock (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right locking mechanism of the box, made of ABS plastic. It mirrors the left lock and is attached to the opposite side of the lid edge.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the left lock to hold the lid securely closed.
parts.Movement_description: It can be pressed or lifted slightly to engage or disengage the locking mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the storage box, made of polypropylene plastic. It forms the container that holds the contents.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and storage space for items placed inside the box.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the foundation for the lid and locks.
